The enrichment targets N-linked glycoproteins, specifically using the SPEG method and PNGase F release, which converts glycosylated asparagines to aspartic acids (mass shift 0.984 Da).

scope: we isolated formerly N-linked glycopeptides from normal prostate (n = 10) and from non-aggressive (n = 24), aggressive (n = 16), and metastatic (n = 25) PCa tumor tissues and analyzed the samples using SWATH mass spectrometry
